26-212 - Resolution on Resident Input Process Before MHS Project Cost Estimates on February 2nd 
  
FULL TEXT AND DESCRIPTION 
Be it Resolved by the Medford City Council and Medford School Committee that we will hold further 
Joint Meetings on January 20, 2027 and February 2, 2027 regarding the Medford High School Building 
Project.  
 
On January 20, 2027, the City Council and School Committee will: 
• Receive a short presentation of answers to frequently asked questions 
• Invite resident input on the project and share answers to resident questions asked up to that 
date 
• Hear additional questions from residents and provide answers from the project team or 
collect those questions to be answered on February 2 
 
On February 2, 2027, the City Council and School Committee will: 
• Review the final project cost estimates at the conclusion of schematic design (Project Team) 
• Review the estimated taxpayer impact of a debt exclusion to fund the project and any planned 
city revenue offsets (City Finance Team) 
• Hear additional questions from residents to be answered by project team and city finance 
team 
 
Residents can send their questions to mhsproject@medford.k12.ma.us 
 
Residents can find answers to a number of frequently asked questions at medfordhsproject.com/faq/ 
  
RECOMMENDATION
